full_page.content:
1953, Sept. 17
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God! In all His designs.
Sept. 17th 1953
God bless you Mrs. Mary Polack -- you and yours. Thanks be to God that the crime you write about did not lead -- as is often the case -- to the actually threatened, worse crime and climax of insanity. To give way to bitterness at such a fall -- such a misfortune? and especially when acknow- ledged on the border of despair !! . . to suicidal danger !? Jesus, who was infinetely more deeply offended be (by) the crime of the poor adultress before Him than ever pharisee could be or even husband gives the solution. For very shame of such an offense to common He would seem to seek escape from discussion with the parisees of so delicate
(unfinished letter)
